meta-montgomery-al.name: Meta Montgomery Data Center
meta-montgomery-al.source: Governor Ivey Announces Meta Plans to Build $800 Million Data Center in Montgomery
meta-montgomery-al.notes: Located off I-65 in southern Montgomery County across from Hyundai Motor Manufacturing Alabama (HMMA) plant (Hope Hull area, approximately I-65 Exit 164). Coordinates corrected to approximate HMMA corridor (~32.185 N, ~86.273 W); original record used central Montgomery city coordinates (32.362, -86.301) which are approximately 13 miles north of the Hyundai plant area. Originally announced as $800M, expanded September 2025 to $1.5B with 1.3M sq ft footprint. Expected online end of 2026. Meta's 24th global data hub and 20th in the US.

novva-mesa-az.name: Novva Mesa Data Center Campus
novva-mesa-az.water_notes: Proprietary water-free air-cooling system projected to conserve up to 650 million gallons of culinary water annually versus comparable evaporative-cooled facility
novva-mesa-az.source: Novva Data Centers Announces New Campus in Mesa
novva-mesa-az.notes: Located near Ellsworth and Warner roads, southeast Mesa. Five data halls, 1.3M sq ft data hall space, 200,000 sq ft office, two-phase buildout over ~10 years. Sixth Novva campus nationally, first in Arizona. Architectural design honors Hohokam heritage. Coordinates approximate.

beale-project-blue-pima-county-az.name: Project Blue
beale-project-blue-pima-county-az.source: Pima County NDA confirms Amazon is behind Project Blue data center
beale-project-blue-pima-county-az.notes: Unincorporated Pima County, west of Houghton Rd, near Tucson. 500-700MW planned across 13M sq ft (a range, so omitted from capacityMw). AWS confirmed as end-customer via an NDA obtained by AZ Luminaria. Distinct site from Beale Infrastructure's Fremont Peak Properties/Luckett Road project in the Town of Marana (also AZ, also tracked this session) - same developer family, different parcel. Coordinates are approximate.

cyrusone-nas-lemoore-ca.name: CyrusOne AI Data Center at NAS Lemoore
cyrusone-nas-lemoore-ca.powered_by: Off-grid microgrid (engine generators built by Ameresco; potential 425MW solar farm on adjacent 920 acres)
cyrusone-nas-lemoore-ca.water_notes: Developer has not disclosed cooling method or water source (arid Central Valley; NAS Lemoore draws from the Kings River). Kings County Supervisor Gilcrease flagged water as a key opposition concern.
cyrusone-nas-lemoore-ca.nearest_power_name: Van der Kooi Dairy Solar Array
cyrusone-nas-lemoore-ca.source: Ameresco and U.S. Navy Partner to Build AI-Optimized Data Center and Energy Infrastructure at NAS Lemoore
cyrusone-nas-lemoore-ca.notes: Located at Naval Air Station Lemoore on the Kings/Fresno county border. Ameresco leads energy infrastructure via its Intelliscale platform; CyrusOne operates the data center for federal and defense AI workloads (FedRAMP, FISMA High, DoD IL5/IL6). Land leased from DOD. Announced September 9, 2025; first phase expected online 2027.

prime-smf02-sacramento-ca.name: Prime Data Centers SMF02
prime-smf02-sacramento-ca.water_notes: Closed-loop water recirculation system reduces consumption vs. traditional evaporative systems. Water Restoration Certificates procured at 120% of annual operating consumption.
prime-smf02-sacramento-ca.source: Prime Data Centers Breaks Ground on Second Sacramento Data Center, Expanding Regional Campus Footprint
prime-smf02-sacramento-ca.notes: Address: 2408 AK Street, McClellan Park, Sacramento, CA 95652. Coordinates approximate (McClellan Business Park). Adjacent to operational SMF01 (8MW at 2407 AK Street). Combined campus: 26MW across 215,000 sq ft on 8.6 acres. Marketed for hyperscale and AI-ready deployments. Certifications: ISO 27001, SOC 2 Type 2.

prologis-rue-ferrari-san-jose-ca.name: Prologis 5853 Rue Ferrari
prologis-rue-ferrari-san-jose-ca.notes: Site Development Permit Amendment converting an existing ~300,000 sq ft warehouse (Parcel #678-05-057, City file H21-006/HA21-006-01) into server-ready R&D space, adding backup generators, transformers, and evaporative cooling chillers. Approved Dec 10 2025 via a Mitigated Negative Declaration w/ Addendum (no significant environmental impacts found); Notice of Determination posted Dec 18 2025. No tenant named yet — next steps are leasing, tenant-improvement permits, and utility interconnection before server halls activate. 140 jobs projected (not delivered) — omitted from jobs numeric. Distinct from the already-tracked prologis-silver-creek-valley-san-jose-ca record and prologis-stem-park-zanker-road-san-jose-ca (this same batch) — different parcels.

stonebridge-fort-meade-fl.name: Florida Ecopark AI Data Center Campus
stonebridge-fort-meade-fl.developer: Stonebridge (via Florida Ecopark LLC; end tenant undisclosed)
stonebridge-fort-meade-fl.water_notes: Stonebridge states it will use a closed-loop system to recycle cooling water; the City of Fort Meade reserved 50,000 gallons/day of potable water for the project (down from an original 150,000-gallon request), which the developer says serves restrooms and kitchens rather than cooling. Residents raised concerns that actual demand could exceed the city's limits, and no SWFWMD water-use permit had been filed as of April 2026.
stonebridge-fort-meade-fl.source: Fort Meade is one step closer to building Florida's first hyperscale AI data center
stonebridge-fort-meade-fl.notes: 1,300-acre former phosphate mine site; 200-acre data center footprint. 20-year development agreement approved by Fort Meade City Commission approximately April 15, 2026. Requires 1.2 GW of electricity. No identified lessee or buyer publicly disclosed. Water use reduced in plans from 140,000 to 50,000 gallons daily; Southwest Florida Water Management District approval pending separately. Florida SB 484 signed May 2026 added new state-level data center siting requirements. Coordinates are Fort Meade city centroid; actual site is former phosphate mine outside city limits.

qts-blue-hole-blakely-ga.name: QTS Project Blue Hole
qts-blue-hole-blakely-ga.source: QTS targets two data center campuses in Georgia
qts-blue-hole-blakely-ga.notes: Project Blue Hole in Blakely, Early County; DRI filed 2026, ~12M sq ft at full buildout by ~2035. ~1 GW+ is an estimate of ultimate scale (in notes). Coordinates are the Blakely area centroid.

tpa-social-circle-technology-park-ga.name: Social Circle Technology Park
tpa-social-circle-technology-park-ga.water_notes: Project representatives were in discussions with the Newton County Water & Sewerage Authority (June 2025), which states it has capacity; no volume or cooling type disclosed.
tpa-social-circle-technology-park-ga.source: TPA Group Plans Massive Newton County Data Center Complex
tpa-social-circle-technology-park-ga.notes: Nine buildings, 2.56 million sq ft near I-20/SR-11 intersection. Construction planned to begin 2028; first phase operational target 2031. Formerly filed as Newton County Technology Park; renamed after jurisdictional ambiguity surfaced. Coordinates corrected to Social Circle city centroid (33.6562°N, 83.7182°W); original record had 33.5912°N which is approximately 4.5 miles south of the actual city center per multiple geocoding sources.

equinix-ch8-minooka-il.name: Equinix CH8 Minooka
equinix-ch8-minooka-il.source: Equinix proposes billion-dollar data center investment in Minooka
equinix-ch8-minooka-il.notes: Proposed ~300-acre, $1B+ Equinix campus in Minooka, Grundy County. Capacity not disclosed (omitted). Coordinates are the Minooka area centroid.

tract-morris-technology-park-il.name: Morris Technology Park
tract-morris-technology-park-il.source: Scaling up: Tract's master-planned land and infrastructure approach to data center development
tract-morris-technology-park-il.notes: 343-acre master-planned data center campus in Morris (Grundy County), IL, developed by Tract as powered land/shell infrastructure. Fully zoned and entitled, with an executed Transmission Security Agreement (TSA) with Commonwealth Edison (ComEd) to support 1 GW (1,000 MW) of planned power at full build-out across ~2.9M sq ft.

powerhouse-louisville-ky.name: PowerHouse Data Centers – Louisville (Camp Ground Road)
powerhouse-louisville-ky.source: Planning Commission recommends approval for 1.6m sq ft planned data center in Louisville, Kentucky
powerhouse-louisville-ky.notes: Address: 6001 Camp Ground Road, Louisville, KY; near Shively and the Rubbertown industrial district, less than 1 mile from the Ohio River. 153 acres confirmed by DCD. 1.6M sq ft total campus across seven buildings. Operator discussing tenants including major hyperscalers (Google, Amazon, Microsoft named in reports). End tenant not publicly disclosed at time of research. Fix: removed unconfirmed '50-year' duration from tax exemption description — program exists per Kentucky 2024 legislation but specific term length was not confirmed by any fetched source.

applied-digital-delta-forge-1-la.name: Applied Digital Delta Forge 1 AI Factory Campus
applied-digital-delta-forge-1-la.water_notes: Applied Digital proprietary closed-loop cooling technology for high-density AI workloads.
applied-digital-delta-forge-1-la.source: Central Louisiana secures $3.6B Applied Digital AI Factory Campus
applied-digital-delta-forge-1-la.notes: Anchor tenant is an undisclosed investment-grade U.S. hyperscaler under a $7.5B, 15-year lease. Two initial facilities totaling 300 MW across 300 acres (of 672-acre secured site). Initial operations targeted mid-2027. Applied Digital HQ in Dallas, TX.

stack-bossier-parish-la.name: Bossier Parish Campus (with Amazon)
stack-bossier-parish-la.source: Campuses of newly-announced Amazon data center spanning Bossier, Caddo parishes confirmed
stack-bossier-parish-la.notes: Companion site to the Blanchard/Caddo Parish campus; same ~$12,000,000,000 combined Amazon/STACK investment.

wiscasset-proposed-me.name: Wiscasset Data Center (Old Ferry Road Site)
wiscasset-proposed-me.source: Wiscasset Loses ARPA Funding After Data Center Proposal, Confusion
wiscasset-proposed-me.notes: Coordinates are approximate, based on Wiscasset area near former Maine Yankee site. Developer identity remains undisclosed per NDA. As of March 2026 Lincoln County reallocated ARPA funds to Waldoboro and Newcastle. Land remains undeveloped. investmentUsd removed: the $5B figure was cited in press at announcement but is not present in the Central Maine article (the only resolvable primary source) and could not be confirmed from any URL that returned content; Maine Morning Star (secondary source) returned HTTP 403. Operator field lists 'Unnamed developer (NDA with town)' as that is the factual status.

stargate-saline-township-mi.name: Stargate The Barn Campus
stargate-saline-township-mi.powered_by: grid (100% utility costs paid by Oracle)
stargate-saline-township-mi.water_notes: Closed-loop cooling system that, per Related Digital, limits daily water use to levels comparable to an office building.
stargate-saline-township-mi.source: Oracle and OpenAI start construction on Stargate campus in Saline Township, Michigan — Data Center Dynamics

thor-equities-augusta-township-mi.name: Thor Equities Augusta Township Data Center (Form8tion)
thor-equities-augusta-township-mi.source: Local officials recommend denial of Thor Equities data center in Michigan
thor-equities-augusta-township-mi.notes: Site north of Milan-Oakville Road, east of Hitchingham Road, Augusta Township, Washtenaw County MI (between Ann Arbor and Monroe). No end user announced; planners cited Google and Microsoft as typical users of this facility type. Form8tion is Thor's digital infrastructure arm (founded March 2023). Capacity not disclosed; at least five large buildings planned. Voter referendum outcome will determine project viability. Coordinates are approximate Augusta Township centroid.

meta-rosemount-mn.name: Meta Rosemount Data Center
meta-rosemount-mn.nearest_power_name: Eolos Wind Energy Research Field Station
meta-rosemount-mn.source: Hello, Rosemount! — Meta Data Centers blog
meta-rosemount-mn.notes: Site is 280 acres of UMore Park (former WWII smokeless powder facility, then Univ. of Minnesota agricultural research land) in Rosemount. Meta's 19th US data center. Coordinates approximate for northern UMore Park area. Additional parcels purchased Feb 2025 via Jimnist LLC for potential expansion; no current build plan on those parcels.

crusoe-warrenton-mo.name: Crusoe Warrenton Campus
crusoe-warrenton-mo.water_notes: Closed-loop cooling system using food-grade polypropylene glycol continuously recycled within the system; no reported MGD figure disclosed. Company claims 40% less water usage compared to a conventional light industrial facility (sourceRef 2).
crusoe-warrenton-mo.source: Crusoe data center could be built west of St. Louis, Missouri
crusoe-warrenton-mo.notes: Coordinates approximate. Site address: 22151 NW Service Road, Warrenton MO; north of NW Service Road, west of Hwy. W. Two 805,000 sq ft data center buildings + 40,000 sq ft administration building + 621,250 sq ft Ameren-owned switch yard + 603,200 sq ft Crusoe-owned electrical substation. Crusoe described as its 'fifth campus' in its national AI data center portfolio as of June 2026 per Crusoe newsroom. Meta signed agreement with Crusoe in June 2026 for approximately 1.6GW of AI computing capacity split across Childress TX and Warrenton MO campuses — per-site split not disclosed; confirms Warrenton as AI anchor customer site (sourceRef 3). Status: conditional use permit and site plan approved; land disturbance review and construction permits still outstanding before groundbreaking. Crusoe committed publicly to seek no real property tax or gross receipt tax abatements; would pursue state incentives only (sourceRef 2). Developer projected annual property taxes ~$80M/year (sourceRef 1), with ~$44M to local schools. Construction jobs projected ~2,000-2,500 over ~3-year build; permanent tech jobs projected ~100 (developer estimates, sourceRef 1 and 2 — not firm contractual commitments). Crusoe historically used on-site flared natural gas but divested those operations; Warrenton campus is grid-connected via Ameren Missouri — no on-site gas generation reported here. Distinct from the Google/Crusoe 'Goodnight' campus in Armstrong County TX.

meta-kansas-city-northland-mo.name: Meta Kansas City Northland
meta-kansas-city-northland-mo.source: Meta's Kansas City Data Center and Upcoming AI-Optimized Data Centers
meta-kansas-city-northland-mo.notes: Located at Golden Plains Technology Park (Diode Ventures development), 801 NW 128th Street, at the northwest corner of I-435 and US-169. Three data center buildings + warehouse, 1.4M sq ft total. Meta's first Missouri data center. Coordinates are approximate for the Golden Plains Technology Park area.

aws-richmond-county-nc.name: Amazon Web Services Richmond County Data Center Campus
aws-richmond-county-nc.source: Amazon breaks ground on $10bn data center complex in Richmond County, North Carolina
aws-richmond-county-nc.notes: Energy Way Industrial Park, Rockingham, NC. Up to 20 buildings each 200,000-225,000 sq ft at full build. No state incentives; only local county tax breaks. MW capacity not publicly disclosed. Coordinates are Rockingham city centroid. Original secondary source (richmondnc.com/CivicAlerts.aspx?AID=168) returned HTTP 404 and was replaced with Business NC article. poweredBy field removed: DCD reports the method of powering has not been publicly confirmed.

andover-hpc-development-nj.name: Andover HPC Data Center (former Newton Airport Site)
andover-hpc-development-nj.source: Old New Jersey Airport Could House New AI Data Center
andover-hpc-development-nj.notes: Coordinates are approximate for Andover Township, Sussex County; exact parcel at 248 Stickles Pond Road. Former Newton Airport closed 2013. No capacity MW disclosed. PILOT estimate of $4.5-5.2M annual revenue cited by mayor. Town moving to ban all data centers as of May 2026, but no project has been formally cancelled since no application was filed.

google-henderson-nv.name: Google Henderson Data Center
google-henderson-nv.source: Google Henderson, Nevada — official location page (built 2019)
google-henderson-nv.notes: Google data center on West Warm Springs Rd (east of Boulder Highway), Henderson, Clark County — two parcels totaling ~64 acres, groundbreaking July 1 2019, a $600M project ($25.2M in state tax incentives), online 2020. Confirmed by Google's own Henderson location page. No site-specific IT-load MW is disclosed. Coordinates are an approximate geocode of the disclosed Warm Springs Rd location; a county-parcel pass could upgrade precision to exact.

60-hudson-street-ny.name: 60 Hudson Street
60-hudson-street-ny.developer: Multi-tenant carrier hotel (Hudson Interxchange, Digital Realty, DataBank, Equinix, and 100+ telecom tenants)
60-hudson-street-ny.source: BBCMS Mortgage Trust 2023-C22 FWP (60 Hudson Street building disclosure)
60-hudson-street-ny.notes: Landmarked 1930 Art Deco former Western Union building in TriBeCa, Manhattan — the East Coast's most important carrier hotel / interconnection point, hosting 100+ telecom and data-center tenants. Represented as ONE consolidated facility record rather than one per tenant, since the physical building is the meaningful unit. Total building size is 1,149,619 sq ft, 24 stories + basement, per an authoritative SEC EDGAR CMBS filing (2023) — this is whole-building square footage, not data-center-specific space. No whole-building data-center power (MW) figure is disclosed by any verifiable primary source; a 50MW figure appears on aggregator sites but traces to an unverified 2014 reference and is not repeated here as fact. The one solidly-verified tenant figure: Hudson Interxchange (HIX) occupies ~173,000 sq ft with a 15MW Con Edison feed (+2MW expansion announced), confirmed via Data Center Dynamics (2024-08-21). Figures for Digital Realty and DataBank's space in this building could not be independently confirmed from primary sources in this research pass (conflicting numbers across aggregator sites) and are deliberately omitted rather than guessed — capacityMw is left unset for the same reason (no reliable whole-building total exists). Coordinates are a building-level geocode from a map aggregator, not independently verified against a primary GIS source.

aws-cosgray-hilliard-oh.name: AWS Cosgray Road Campus
aws-cosgray-hilliard-oh.source: AWS Hilliard campuses coverage (Cosgray Road enrichment)
aws-cosgray-hilliard-oh.notes: Separate AWS Hilliard campus on Cosgray Road, in active litigation: the City of Hilliard appealed an Ohio EPA air permit for a 228-unit Bloom Energy fuel-cell array (73MW, the largest fuel-cell array in North America), and AWS is separately seeking a permit for 158 diesel backup generators. Approved by the Ohio Power Siting Board under Ohio's HB15 behind-the-meter law, overriding local zoning. Distinct from the Scioto Darby campus. Coordinates are now parcel-exact via the Franklin County Auditor (parcel 050-011455, 4580-4640 Cosgray Rd, Amazon Data Services Inc, data-center use class, ~95 ac).

bitdeer-clarington-oh.name: Bitdeer Clarington HPC/AI Campus
bitdeer-clarington-oh.source: Bitdeer announces November 2025 production and operations update
bitdeer-clarington-oh.notes: Clarington, Monroe County; 570 MW via an AEP Ohio LOA, targeted available by end of Q3 2026. Bitdeer transitioning from bitcoin mining toward HPC/AI. Coordinates are the Clarington area centroid. No Clarington-specific capex, water, or jobs figures are disclosed; Bitdeer's 2026 mining capex guidance is company-wide and excludes AI/HPC. Some cooling/jobs figures in secondary coverage describe Bitdeer's separate Shalersville (Portage County) site, not Clarington.

bitdeer-shalersville-portage-county-oh.name: Bitdeer Shalersville Data Center Campus
bitdeer-shalersville-portage-county-oh.source: Local developer, global tech firm plan major data center project in Portage County
bitdeer-shalersville-portage-county-oh.notes: Turnpike Commerce Center, Shalersville Township, Portage County. Not yet approved — blocked by the township's active data-center moratorium (see community field). Distinct from Bitdeer's other tracked Ohio sites (Clarington, Whitetail Creek/Niles, and Massillon). Tax revenue projections ($2.17M annual increase at phase-1 completion) are Bitdeer's own company projections, not independently confirmed. Coordinates are an approximate geocode of Shalersville Township, not a confirmed parcel pin — no source gave exact site coordinates.

google-lancaster-oh.name: Google Lancaster Data Center
google-lancaster-oh.notes: 105 Whiley Rd, Lancaster — distinct from Google's New Albany and Lima "Project BOSC" Ohio facilities. No site-specific investment figure is disclosed; Google has only published cumulative bundled totals across its New Albany+Lancaster+Columbus Ohio campuses ($1.7B Aug 2023, +$2.3B June 2024, ~$4.4B+ cumulative since 2019). No IT-load MW figure publicly disclosed. One 2024 article notes future buildings will "support Google's artificial intelligence innovation," but this is generic AI-as-one-of-many-workloads boilerplate rather than facility-specific AI/HPC/GPU marketing — no aiClassification set. Coordinates are an approximate geocode.

microsoft-hebron-oh.name: Microsoft Hebron Data Center
microsoft-hebron-oh.water_notes: Microsoft's Licking County datacenters use direct evaporative cooling per Microsoft; county filings cite a ~252 gal/min water-capacity request for Hebron (a capacity request, not metered consumption). No confirmed operational MGD figure is published.
microsoft-hebron-oh.source: Hebron datacenter construction update - Microsoft Local
microsoft-hebron-oh.notes: 223 acres west of Ohio 79, between North High Street and Canyon Road, Hebron OH 43025. Six-data-center campus planned. Part of Microsoft's $1B Licking County commitment; individual site investment not separately disclosed. Coordinates are approximate Hebron village area. The $1B figure is Microsoft's three-campus Licking County commitment (not disaggregated); an 'up to $3B' Hebron figure appears only in a secondary blog and is not a committed capital-expenditure figure.

iren-woods-county-ok.name: IREN Woods County Campus
iren-woods-county-ok.notes: ~2,000-acre land bank near Alva, Woods County, with a secured 1.6 GW power allocation on the Southwest Power Pool grid; initial power ramp scheduled for 2028. IREN's land-bank expansion beyond its operational Texas campuses (Childress, Sweetwater). Single-tracker source → confidence reported. Coordinates are the Alva area centroid.

meta-anthem-tulsa-ok.name: Meta Project Anthem — Tulsa
meta-anthem-tulsa-ok.water_notes: Water-efficient closed-loop liquid-cooled system. Meta states zero water use for the majority of the year and a water-positive goal by 2030. Water restoration partnership with Phytech across ~1,500 acres targeting 50+ million gallons of annual water savings. Additional partnership with Tulsa Community Foundation on water stewardship. No reportedMgd figure confirmed.
meta-anthem-tulsa-ok.source: Breaking Ground on a New AI-Optimized Data Center in Tulsa, Oklahoma
meta-anthem-tulsa-ok.notes: Codename: Project Anthem (used in TMAPC filings; Meta confirmed publicly April 21, 2026). Meta's 28th US data center and 32nd globally; first in Oklahoma and first built within Tulsa city limits. Anchor tenant at Fair Oaks Innovation Park (a 2,000-acre campus) near 11th Street and Creek Turnpike, East Tulsa. Investment stated as 'more than $1 billion' by Meta — a floor figure only; PartnerTulsa estimates construction costs at ~$800M. investmentUsd omitted: no firm single confirmed figure. Facility size: 2+ million sq ft; completion targeted 2028; general contractor Fortis Construction. No facility-specific MW capacity disclosed; Meta separately adding 1,500+ MW of clean energy to the Oklahoma grid statewide. Jobs: Meta states 'more than 1,000 construction workers at peak' and 'approximately 100 permanent jobs' — approximations from press release, not firm figures; omitted from numeric fields. Phase 2 expansion (375 additional acres west of original parcel, developer Atmoss LLC) proposed but withdrawn March 2026 before city council vote. Coordinates approximate (near 11th St & Creek Turnpike, East Tulsa).

muncy-data-center-lycoming-county-pa.name: Muncy Data Center
muncy-data-center-lycoming-county-pa.source: Site plan offers details on Muncy data center proposal
muncy-data-center-lycoming-county-pa.notes: Three-building data center complex (two 14-pod facilities and one eight-pod facility) with water storage/treatment infrastructure along John Brady Drive in Muncy Township, eastern Lycoming County. Site engineering by Livic Civil; applicant Danko Holdings II/Fishlips LLC.

sentinel-east-whiteland-chester-county-p.name: Sentinel East Whiteland Data Center
sentinel-east-whiteland-chester-county-p.source: Sentinel Data Centers announces 300 MW Sentinel East Whiteland Data Center in PA
sentinel-east-whiteland-chester-county-p.notes: Site: 13 S. Bacton Hill Rd, former Foote Mineral Superfund site. Coordinates are approximate for the township.

triboro-industrial-park-jessup-olyphant-.name: Triboro Industrial Park / Triboro Commerce Park
triboro-industrial-park-jessup-olyphant-.source: PPL Electric Utilities confirms data centers spurred transmission project in Lackawanna County
triboro-industrial-park-jessup-olyphant-.notes: Jessup/Olyphant border. Converted from a 4-warehouse plan to up to 9 proposed data centers; ~$80M land acquisition; first building targeted 2027. Rezoning/litigation resolved via an Olyphant Borough Council settlement. PPL confirmed a transmission project is being built to serve it but would not name the customer (NDA). One of three competing, previously-untracked proposals in the Lackawanna County cluster (see also Project Gravity and Wildcat Ridge, both added this session). Coordinates are approximate.

wildcat-ridge-archbald-lackawanna-county.name: Wildcat Ridge AI Data Center Campus
wildcat-ridge-archbald-lackawanna-county.source: Data centers are poised to engulf a Pennsylvania town
wildcat-ridge-archbald-lackawanna-county.notes: Business Route 6 / Wildcat Rd; 400-574 acres (a range across sources, so omitted from landAcres). 14 three-story buildings, ~17.2M sq ft total. In zoning approval process; developer 'resting its case' as of June 2026. One of three competing, previously-untracked proposals in the Lackawanna County cluster (see also Project Gravity and Triboro Industrial Park, both added this session). Coordinates are approximate.

google-moncks-corner-sc.name: Google Berkeley County Data Center (Moncks Corner)
google-moncks-corner-sc.source: Google Berkeley County, South Carolina — official location page: 'one of our first data centers in the United States', operational since 2007
google-moncks-corner-sc.notes: Google's flagship South Carolina data center in the Mount Holly / Moncks Corner area of Berkeley County — one of Google's first U.S. data centers, operational since 2007, expanded since. Google states $13B+ invested in South Carolina since 2007 (a statewide figure spanning Berkeley + the tracked Dorchester County sites, not site-specific). DISTINCT from the tracked Google Ridgeville (Project Dawson) and St. George (Winding Woods) campuses, which are in Dorchester County. No site-specific IT-load MW is disclosed. Coordinates are an approximate geocode of a disclosed campus address; a county-parcel pass could upgrade precision to exact.

gemini-data-center-sioux-falls-sd.name: Sioux Falls Technology Park (Gemini Data Center)
gemini-data-center-sioux-falls-sd.powered_by: Grid (Xcel Energy; adjacent to Xcel's Split Rock substation)
gemini-data-center-sioux-falls-sd.source: Hyperscale data center seeking city approvals to build northeast of Sioux Falls
gemini-data-center-sioux-falls-sd.notes: aiClassification is 'likely' (not 'confirmed'): Gemini is the land developer, no tenant is signed, and only developer aspiration to attract a hyperscale/AI/neocloud tenant is on record. Capacity (500 MW) and acreage per SiouxFalls.Business; an earlier report cited 160 acres. Coordinates are approximate for the northeast Sioux Falls site. As a developer land project with no signed tenant, its water, subsidy, investment, and job figures remain developer projections only (South Dakota has no state income tax and rejected data-center incentive bills); all recorded as honest-zeros pending a confirmed tenant.

google-montgomery-county-tn.name: Google Montgomery County Data Center
google-montgomery-county-tn.source: Governor Haslam Announces Google to Locate New Data Center in Clarksville
google-montgomery-county-tn.notes: Address: 1000 Boolean Dr, Clarksville, TN 37040 (former Hemlock Semiconductor site). Coordinates are approximate for that site. Google reports $2.5B+ total Tennessee investment since 2018 but facility-level investment is $600M. 30% veteran workforce. Correction: Original announcement was December 2015 (not 2018); facility opened November 2019 (not 2022).

cipher-milsing-huntsville-walker-tx.name: Cipher Milsing HPC Data Center
cipher-milsing-huntsville-walker-tx.source: Cipher Digital (Cipher Mining) FY2025 Form 10-K — Milsing Site, East Texas, targeted capacity up to 500 MW, energize 2028-2029; option exercised Dec 2025
cipher-milsing-huntsville-walker-tx.notes: Cipher's Milsing HPC/AI data center site near Huntsville, Texas (Walker County, northeast of Houston); ~187 acres. Targeted capacity up to 500 MW; estimated energization 2028-2029 (aggregators list a 2027 target). Cipher entered an option agreement in October 2024 and exercised the option in December 2025. Part of Cipher's ~3.4 GW / 8-site HPC pipeline (Cipher Digital, formerly Cipher Mining). Coordinates approximate (Huntsville, TX geocode).

comanche-circle-sailfish-hood-county-tx.name: Comanche Circle
comanche-circle-sailfish-hood-county-tx.source: Sailfish plans multi-gigawatt data center park outside DFW, Texas
comanche-circle-sailfish-hood-county-tx.notes: Near Vistra's Comanche Peak Nuclear Plant. Developer states a 5GW total pipeline across 9 campuses; a later, scaled-back figure puts Comanche Circle plus two smaller Sailfish projects combined at 'up to 3 gigawatts' - given conflicting figures, no single capacityMw is recorded here. Conditional county approval Jan 2026; construction targeted late 2026. No hyperscaler tenant confirmed - speculative developer-led land assembly. Coordinates are approximate.

core-scientific-pecos-tx.name: Core Scientific Pecos AI Campus
core-scientific-pecos-tx.source: Core Scientific plans expansion to 1.5 gigawatts of gross power at Pecos, Texas campus
core-scientific-pecos-tx.notes: High-density AI/HPC colocation. ~1.5 GW gross / ~1.0 GW leasable is an expansion ceiling (in notes). Co-located in Reeves County with Microsoft's separate 'Project Kirby' Pecos campus (distinct operator/parcel; tracked separately). Address on record: 1939 FM 2119. Core Scientific historically a bitcoin miner, repositioned to HDC. Coordinates are the Pecos area centroid. No Pecos-specific capex is disclosed (Q4 FY2025 capex of $279.2M is company-wide; the $226.2M CoreWeave-funded portion is contract revenue, not capex) -> investmentUsd omitted. No Reeves County abatement attributable to Core Scientific was found (the 'Pecos Power Plant LLC' abatement is a separate gas-plant entity).

fluidstack-abernathy-tx.name: Fluidstack Abernathy AI Campus
fluidstack-abernathy-tx.source: TeraWulf and Fluidstack to develop Texas data center in Google-backed deal
fluidstack-abernathy-tx.notes: ~120-acre campus in Abernathy (Hale/Lubbock counties). Distinct from the separately-tracked Aligned 'Project Caprock' Abernathy campus (313 acres, different operator/parcel). 168 MW critical IT load (240 MW gross). Google-backed via a ~$1.3B lease obligation backstop. The frequently cited $9.5B is 25-year contracted revenue, not capex (in notes only). NOTE: the Anthropic lease associated with this deal is at TeraWulf's Justified/Hawesville KY campus, not Abernathy. Coordinates are the Abernathy town centroid.

galaxy-helios-dickens-county-tx.name: Galaxy Helios Data Center Campus
galaxy-helios-dickens-county-tx.water_notes: Phase 1 (133 MW) is a liquid-cooled AI deployment with 90+ chillers and associated piping (Clayco). Chiller condenser type (air-cooled vs. water-cooled/evaporative) and water-consumption (MGD) not published. Site overlies the Ogallala Aquifer on the southern High Plains — a material water-risk context flag.
galaxy-helios-dickens-county-tx.source: Galaxy secures 1.6 GW ERCOT approval at Helios campus in Texas
galaxy-helios-dickens-county-tx.notes: Converted from Bitcoin mining to AI/HPC. CoreWeave is the anchor tenant using the campus for large-scale AI model training. Location is near Afton, Dickens County (West Texas). Original site was 160 acres; campus has since expanded to 2,200+ acres across multiple phases. Coordinates are approximate.

mara-site-mat-1177-matagorda-tx.name: Site MAT 1177
mara-site-mat-1177-matagorda-tx.source: MARA signs agreement with HIF to acquire strategic powered land site
mara-site-mat-1177-matagorda-tx.notes: ~1,200 acres approximately 90 miles SW of Houston; up to 2,000MW long-term. Coordinates are a COUNTY-CENTROID approximation — exact city undisclosed.

tract-caldwell-valley-uhland-tx.name: Tract Caldwell Valley Technology Park
tract-caldwell-valley-uhland-tx.source: Tract closes acquisition of 1,515 acres in Caldwell County, Texas for multi-gigawatt data center technology park
tract-caldwell-valley-uhland-tx.notes: 1,515-acre megasite in Caldwell County (Uhland area, between Austin and San Antonio); over 2 GW at full buildout (expansion toward ~4 GW is a ceiling — in notes), initial 360 MW utility delivery H1 2028 via Blue Bonnet Electric Cooperative. Land acquisition closed May 2025 (pre-construction). Coordinates are the Uhland area centroid.

beacon-westline-dove-creek-san-angelo-tx.name: Westline Site / Dove Creek Technology Campus
beacon-westline-dove-creek-san-angelo-tx.developer: Beacon Data Centers (via Westline TX Holdings)
beacon-westline-dove-creek-san-angelo-tx.location: San Angelo (Tankersley area, unincorporated), Tom Green, TX
beacon-westline-dove-creek-san-angelo-tx.source: TCEQ Air Quality Permit No. 184380 application (Westline TX Holdings)
beacon-westline-dove-creek-san-angelo-tx.notes: Anchored to TCEQ Air Quality Permit application #184380 filed by Westline TX Holdings (Beacon Data Centers). Site is ~1,240 buildable acres near the FM 2335 / US-67 South junction along Spring Creek, Precinct 4, Tom Green County. County commissioners rejected a proposed 12-month data-center moratorium 2026-06-02, citing litigation risk — an implicit but real signal the project is proceeding through the county's process. No MW capacity or investment figure disclosed in any source reviewed; left null per zero-fabrication rule. Coordinates are an approximate geocode of the named road junction (Tankersley, TX), not a parcel centroid — recommend verifying against the TCEQ permit's exact site description if available. Single-source (Concho Observer reporting a TCEQ air-quality permit application); recorded reported-tier pending a second corroborating primary.

cyrusone-dugway-proving-ground-tooele-co.name: CyrusOne Dugway Proving Ground Data Center
cyrusone-dugway-proving-ground-tooele-co.developer: CyrusOne (in exclusive negotiations with the US Army)
cyrusone-dugway-proving-ground-tooele-co.source: Army reaches conditional agreement with private industry for hyperscaled data centers
cyrusone-dugway-proving-ground-tooele-co.notes: Conditionally selected, currently in exclusive negotiations with the US Army (not finalized); expected completion ~2029. Would be CyrusOne's first Utah facility, developed in partnership with Carlyle. Framed as AI-driven Army infrastructure ('AI is a strategic asset... force multiplier' per the Army Secretary) rather than marketed as a standalone AI-brand product. Coordinates are approximate.

amazon-blackwell-road-warrenton-va.name: Blackwell Road Data Center (Warrenton)
amazon-blackwell-road-warrenton-va.source: Warrenton town staff approves site plan for Amazon data center (SUP-22-3)
amazon-blackwell-road-warrenton-va.notes: Town of Warrenton SUP-22-3; 220,000 sq ft on 42 acres; site plan approved with 27 conditions (Apr 2024).

bull-church-data-center-caroline-va.name: Bull Church Data Center
bull-church-data-center-caroline-va.source: Caroline County rezoning case RZ-04-2024, Bull Church Data Center
bull-church-data-center-caroline-va.notes: Case referenced in local press as a long-pending 'zombie' rezoning (originally filed 2024, still active through March 2025 BOS agenda). No anchor tenant/operator beyond the landowner applicant is publicly named — speculative land rezoning, not yet an operator-committed campus.

convergent-technology-park-remington-fau.name: Convergent Technology Park
convergent-technology-park-remington-fau.source: Fauquier County planning staff project database (maintained record of application status)
convergent-technology-park-remington-fau.notes: HONEST INTAKE per prompt guidance: status is application 'on hold, not yet accepted' by the county — real filing, real acreage/investment figures reported, but pre-acceptance. Recorded as status=proposed with the hold explicitly noted rather than dropped, since it is a genuine, citable county application (not rumor). Sourced from the Fauquier County planning-database roundup (fauquiernow.com); status is early/speculative — a per-project county docket should confirm before elevating confidence.

microsoft-tunstall-road-hillcrest-meckle.name: Microsoft Tunstall Road Campus (Hillcrest / AVC09)
microsoft-tunstall-road-hillcrest-meckle.source: NAO-2013-01922, Hillcrest Data Center, Mecklenburg County
microsoft-tunstall-road-hillcrest-meckle.notes: A genuinely separate Microsoft campus filing: 132-acre site at 210 Tunstall Road (north of South Hill, between N. Mecklenburg Ave and I-85), internally referred to as the 'Hillcrest Data Center' (AVC09), part of Microsoft's Regional Network Group. Land acquired ~2020, zoning approved early 2021, three data center buildings + substation planned, build-out targeted ~2024. USACE Norfolk District docket NAO-2013-01922 'Hillcrest Data Center, Mecklenburg County' is the primary federal permit citation (case number is anomalous — likely a docket-numbering artifact reused from an earlier case series;

tract-mountain-road-technology-park-hano.name: Mountain Road Technology Park
tract-mountain-road-technology-park-hano.water_notes: Estimated 600,000–2,000,000 gallons/day; Hanover relies on the City of Richmond for water.
tract-mountain-road-technology-park-hano.source: Data center developer Tract proposes Mountain Road Tech Park in western Hanover County
tract-mountain-road-technology-park-hano.notes: Tract (with Marchetti Properties, via Valco Hanover County 4 LLC) sought to rezone ~427 acres from A1 Agricultural to M1 at 13074 Mountain Road / 12517 Winns Church Road (US Route 33) on the Hanover-Henrico line near the Chickahominy River — five data center buildings, up to three substations, hundreds of MW of demand. Aligned with Hanover's Route 33 Gateway Small Area Plan. Distinct from Tract's Tuckahoe Technology Park in Goochland County. Coordinates are an approximate geocode of the Route 33 / Mountain Road corridor in western Hanover near the Henrico line.

thornburg-business-park-data-center-spot.name: Thornburg Business Park
thornburg-business-park-data-center-spot.developer: LID, LLC (with IWG Thornburg, LLC and JR Bluestar Thornburg, LLC)
thornburg-business-park-data-center-spot.source: Spotsylvania County — Thornburg Business Park rezoning Impact Statement (R25-0013; applicant LID LLC; 9 parcels; ~200.35 ac; ~2M sq ft data center)
thornburg-business-park-data-center-spot.notes: County rezoning case R25-0013. Applicant/owner LID, LLC & IWG Thornburg, LLC & JR Bluestar Thornburg, LLC. Rezoning of ~200.35 acres (tax map parcels 63-12-E, 63-12-D, 63-12-C, 63-A-33, 63-A-32, 63-A-37, 76-A-5, 76-A-5A, 76-A-6) from A-2 and C-3 to I-2 to develop a Data Center and Public Utility (Light) campus of ~2,000,000 sq ft of data center buildings; SW quadrant of the Route 1 / Route 606 intersection (5630 Morris Rd / 5600 Blue Star Ln), behind the Food Lion. Filed 9/25/2025; Under Review per the March 2026 county report. Mangum Economics fiscal analysis ("Spotsylvania Data Center Campus", June 2025) projects county tax revenue $5.4M (year 1) rising to ~$50.4M steady, and ~216 data center operational jobs. Distinct from Thornburg Industrial Park (parcels 63-5-C/63-5-C1, S Roxbury Mill Rd) and SpotsyTech Campus (N Roxbury Mill Rd). Coordinates approximate (Morris Rd geocode; parcels not GIS-confirmed this pass).

vint-hill-corners-fauquier-va.name: Vint Hill Corners
vint-hill-corners-fauquier-va.source: Fauquier County planning staff project database (maintained record of application status)
vint-hill-corners-fauquier-va.notes: By-right project (no rezoning needed), awaiting a site plan submission — a step further along than the Remington 'on-hold' cluster. Same Vint Hill locality as tracked CyrusOne project but confirmed distinct parcel/applicant. Fauquier planning-database roundup; distinct parcel from the tracked CyrusOne Vint Hill campus (verified) but near-name — flagged.

meta-beaver-dam-wi.name: Meta Beaver Dam Data Center Campus
meta-beaver-dam-wi.water_notes: Dry cooling — no water consumption for cooling once operational; 570 acres of wetland/prairie restoration surrounding facility via Ducks Unlimited partnership
meta-beaver-dam-wi.source: Hello, Beaver Dam! — Meta Data Centers blog
meta-beaver-dam-wi.notes: Coordinates are approximate city centroid for Beaver Dam; exact site is Alliant Energy Beaver Dam Commerce Park (Wisconsin's largest certified development-ready site). 700,000+ sq ft campus. Meta's 26th US data center. AI workloads are the stated purpose.
